# Demo photography

These photographs are bundled with Irodori for its offline demo workspace. They are
free to use under the [Unsplash License](https://unsplash.com/license), verified
on September 15, 2026. The license permits downloading, copying, modifying, and
distributing images, including for commercial use. The photographers retain
their copyright. Do not sell these images as unmodified standalone photographs
or use them to compile a competing image service.

| Bundled file         | Photographer    | Original photograph                                                       |
| -------------------- | --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `alpine-lake.jpg`    | Luca Bravo      | [Boathouse on a mountain lake](https://unsplash.com/photos/VowIFDxogG4)   |
| `mountain-ridge.jpg` | Luca Bravo      | [Mountain at golden hour](https://unsplash.com/photos/aIeukKl3raU)        |
| `forest-light.jpg`   | Sebastian Unrau | [Entering another dimension](https://unsplash.com/photos/sp-p7uuT0tw)     |
| `quiet-valley.jpg`   | Nathalie Lays   | [Dawn at Emerald Lake](https://unsplash.com/photos/gTQ8U8NbDEc)           |
| `coastal-dunes.jpg`  | Colin Lloyd     | [Great Sand Dunes National Park](https://unsplash.com/photos/-IyFkzVo_7A) |

Each image was downloaded from the original page's `images.unsplash.com` image
source as a JPEG, resized by the image CDN to a maximum width of 1920 pixels at
quality 86. The files have no local color edits. The `coastal-dunes` fixture ID
is an internal sample name; the photographed dunes are in Colorado.

Source image identifiers, in table order:

- `photo-1470770903676-69b98201ea1c`
- `photo-1508144234962-087c012cc70b`
- `photo-1448375240586-882707db888b`
- `photo-1761205930565-1283c2348ac5`
- `photo-1619408507579-368cba59746f`

Download URL format:
`https://images.unsplash.com/IMAGE_ID?auto=format&fit=max&w=1920&q=86&fm=jpg`.

The names, dates, and camera settings displayed by the demo are sample data,
not EXIF extracted from these JPEGs. Photographer credits describe the actual
photographers and are also shown below the preview.
